purpose: Human/ADR-owned intent for AI-copilot-chat capabilities. This file says what's approved or planned — never what's built. What's actually built is derived from the codebase itself by tools/capabilities/generate.php and never hand-edited here. tools/capabilities/diff.php gates the two against each other: approved-but-unbuilt and built-but-undeclared both fail; planned/deferred entries place no requirement on code.

states.approved: Required. Must have a @capability-tagged test in the codebase, and that test must pass. Missing or failing hard-fails the capability gate.
states.planned: On the roadmap, not required yet. Absence is fine. If code already proves it, the gate leaves a non-blocking note to promote it to 'approved'.
states.deferred: Explicitly out of scope for now (see linked ADR/decision if any). Absence is fine; presence is fine (not penalized), just not required.

chat.copilot-drawer-close.note: The AI Copilot drawer must always expose a reachable, accessibly-named close control that restores access to primary navigation — the real regression this system was built to catch (2026-09-02 deployed-instance finding).

nav.bottom-nav-contract.note: The default floating bottom nav must render exactly the slots App\Models\User::getBottomNavSlots() declares as default. Source of truth is the PHP default array, not docs/ui-spec/navigation-tree.json (which has already drifted once).

chat.no-raw-backend-errors.note: No raw shell/stack-trace signature may ever render in the executive-facing chat transcript (regression: 'Outlook MCP bridge error: sh: 1: exec: uv: not found' leaking verbatim — see issue #40 for the underlying uv-missing root cause, tracked separately from this UI-leak fix).

chat.stop-generation.note: No way to abort a long-running AI turn mid-flight; only a spinner. Table-stakes chat-UX mechanic, not a scope decision — safe to build without a flow-of-events pass.

chat.regenerate-response.note: No way to regenerate the last assistant response or edit-and-resend a user message.

chat.copy-message.note: No copy-to-clipboard affordance on assistant messages.

chat.markdown-rendering.note: Assistant content renders via nl2br(e(...)) only — plain text, no markdown/code-block/list rendering. A structured action summary from the model currently renders as a wall of text.

chat.message-stream-live-region.note: The message stream has no aria-live region — new messages arriving via Livewire are not announced to screen readers.

chat.web-browsing.note: Not evaluated. DPIK Tadbir is a bounded executive tool operating only through declared MCP tools (AGENTS.md rule 2) — this needs its own flow-of-events pass before it belongs on this list at all, not a benchmark-driven addition.

chat.voice-input.note: Same as chat.web-browsing — needs a flow-of-events pass, not a benchmark-driven addition.
